tldr: Global tech markets experienced a significant sell-off driven by concerns over US inflation and the financial health of the AI sector.
The ongoing conflict between Russia and Ukraine escalated with renewed strikes on energy infrastructure by both sides.
A school roof collapse in Pakistan tragically killed at least 33 pupils and a teacher.

market.why: Global tech markets experienced a significant sell-off, with chip makers and tech investors seeing plunges, driven by fears over US inflation and the financial health of the AI sector, which spooked markets. Wholesale prices also saw their biggest annual jump since 2022, adding to inflation concerns.

yield_10y.why: Treasury yields slid as investors moved towards the perceived safety of government bonds amidst the tech market rout, indicating a broader flight to safety.

vix.why: The VIX increased amid a broad tech market sell-off and heightened investor fears regarding US inflation and the financial stability within the AI ecosystem.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_upcoming.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: ACA marketplace open enrollment opens — expected early November
policy_calendar.note: healthcare.gov has opened enrollment on November 1 each year, and currently publishes December 15 as the deadline for coverage starting January 1. The window is set by federal rule and has been changed by rulemaking before.

policy_calendar.label: IRS 401(k) and IRA contribution limits for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: The annual cost-of-living adjustment notice, historically released within a week or two of the bracket figures. It sets how much can go into a 401(k) and an IRA next year.

policy_calendar.label: IRS tax brackets and the married-filing-jointly standard deduction for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: Published as an annual inflation-adjustment revenue procedure; recent releases landed between mid-October and mid-November. These are the bracket thresholds and the standard deduction the next return is filed against.

tech.summary: TSMC is experiencing a fierce battle for chip manufacturing capacity among major AI customers like Nvidia, Apple, Broadcom, and AMD, despite reporting a record quarter.

Amazon has launched new 'personal AI' devices, the Bee Frontier and Bee Eclipse, designed to listen to conversations; the Bee Frontier is an upgraded wearable bracelet and the Bee Eclipse attaches to smartphones.

Security researchers have found evidence that an Israeli ad tech firm worked with spyware companies to infect devices, including those at Al Jazeera, through zero-click attacks delivered via online ads.

world.summary: The conflict in Ukraine escalated as Russia launched drone attacks on infrastructure and President Zelenskyy announced a resumption of strikes on Russian oil refineries, effectively collapsing a previous 'energy ceasefire' effort.
At least 33 pupils and one teacher were killed after a school roof collapsed in Peshawar, north-west Pakistan, burying children under debris.

The cost of balancing Great Britain's power grid has soared to nearly £50 million a day, due to the grid operator paying to switch off windfarms in areas of excess electricity and simultaneously turning on gas plants elsewhere.
Delegates from over 10 countries walked out during an address by Israeli President Isaac Herzog at a summit in Baku.

us.summary: President Trump reversed an earlier plan to livestream the execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan, following a widespread outcry.
The Social Security program could face financial shortfalls as early as 2032, potentially impacting full payments to retirees, with various solutions under examination.
Survivors of the 2025 wildfires in Los Angeles are encountering further delays with a FEMA program intended to assist the most vulnerable victims in rebuilding their homes.

science.summary: New guidance from NHS England states that trans patients should be cared for in single-sex hospital wards or bays that align with their biological sex.
Researchers have successfully revived pig kidneys that were cooled to -150 °C and stored in a freezer for months, demonstrating a potential breakthrough in organ preservation.
